headline: How I Can Help
subheadline: From custom web builds to enterprise systems work — practical software help scoped to what your business actually needs.

offerings.title: Custom Web & App Development

includes: UI/UX design in Figma before a line of code

offerings.title: AI-Assisted Development & Modernization
offerings.description: Bringing AI-assisted workflows into existing codebases — faster iteration, better documentation, safer refactors — without sacrificing code quality or understanding of what's actually being shipped.

offerings.title: Ongoing Support & Maintenance
